21K likes, 536 comments - apple on October 20, 2026: "Above Rose Valley, the runway looks different.

The day before the @lesbenjamins show, director @neels.castillon sent iPhone into the sky over Cappadocia, mounted on custom-built drones. 

Titled “From Earth to Sky”, the fashion film captures the surreal anniversary collection.

#ShotoniPhone18Pro by @neels.castillon".

49K likes, 751 comments - apple on October 16, 2026: "The wild yellow tulips of Cappadocia was a key inspiration behind @lesbenjamins 15-year anniversary. Their shapes and colors inform both the collection and the accompanying hot air balloons (no, no AI was used), while seventies Turkish psychedelic rock influenced the silhouettes, palette, and music playing during the show.

#ShotoniPhone18Pro".

94K likes, 1,334 comments - apple on October 14, 2026: "“I see my role as being a translator and a bridge between east and west,” says Bünyamin Aydin. 

For @lesbenjamins 15-year anniversary, the Turkish designer invited his community to Cappadocia’s Rose Valley to showcase his ‘From Earth to Sky’ collection up close – with a fashion show set against a vibrant backdrop of abstract hot air balloons. And no, they’re not AI.

#ShotoniPhone18Pro".
